summary: Loma Prieta's 1927 wooden lookout gave way to a 1934 steel tower, removed around 1976. A recent state notice describes a communications tower complex there.

facts.design: US Forest Service BC-301 cabin on a 30-foot enclosed K-brace steel tower (1934)
facts.status_note: The lookout was removed around 1976. A recent state notice describes a communications tower complex at Loma Prieta.

corrections.why: The register gives a 30-foot tower (9.1 m). 18.3 m is 60 feet, the height in a 1933 newspaper report that the register does not use.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The 1927 wooden station and tower came first. The register's 1934 date belongs to the steel tower and BC-301 cabin that replaced it.
The register gives 30 feet (9.1 m) for the 1934 tower. A 1934 plan said 35 feet and a 1933 report said 60 feet. We use the register's figure because it describes the 1934 structure.

sources.title: Loma Prieta Communication Tower Wildfire Protection

notes_for_editor: No source describes the lookout footprint today. The CEQAnet notice describes a communications tower complex at Loma Prieta but does not say whether it sits on the old lookout site; check a map before saying more. Access is not documented anywhere. Height disagrees across sources (30 ft register, 35 ft 1934 plan, 60 ft 1933 report). The 1933 'first ever' claim conflicts with the 1927 wooden tower. No fire at the lookout was found. History comes from newspaper clippings reprinted on californialookouts.weebly.com; originals were not checked.
